paper.title: Disk Evolution Study Through Imaging of Nearby Young Stars (DESTINYS): The SPHERE view of the Orion star-forming region

notes: F7 young star in Orion; the held SPHERE/IRDIS H-band total-intensity image from DESTINYS reveals a possible substellar companion (a very low-mass star or high-mass brown dwarf) 137 au from the star, while no disk is detected in polarized light (Valegard et al. 2024).
